title: ...build a debt elimination payoff plan
desc: Gain momentum paying off credit cards and personal loans systematically.
todos: List all outstanding debts with exact balances, minimum payments, and interest rates.
Organize list from smallest balance to largest balance (Snowball Method).
Pay minimum required payment on all accounts except smallest balance debt.
Throw all extra disposable income toward eliminating smallest debt balance.
Roll entire payment amount from paid-off debt into next smallest balance.
